_doc: Video endpoint config. deploy.py fetches each candidate's GPU memory and host RAM, keeps those meeting the plan thresholds, orders the pool cheapest first, and (when SageMaker pricing lacks ap-south-1 g7e) falls back to the EC2 on-demand price with a note. ml.g7e.2xlarge is excluded: 64 GB host RAM cannot hold the CPU-offloaded text encoder.
